[Intro]
[E]

[Verse 1]
[E]I want love to:
[G]roll me over slowly,
[A]Stick a knife inside me, and
[E]twist it all around.
I want love to:
[G]grab my fingers gently,
[A]Slam them in a doorway, Put my
[E]face into the ground.
I want love to:
[G]murder my own mother, and
[A]Take her off to somewhere, like
[E]hell, or up above. And
I want love to: chan-
[G]ge my friends to enemies, Chan-
[A]ge my friends to enemies, And
[E]show me how it's all my fault. And

[Chorus]
[E]I won't let [G]love disrupt, cor-
[D]rupt or interrupt [A]me
[E]I won't let [G]love disrupt, cor-
[D]rupt or interrupt [A]me Yeah
[E]I won't let [G]love disrupt, cor-
[D]rupt or interrupt [A]me, anymore.

[Bridge]
[E]  [G]
[E]  [G]

[Verse 2]
[E]I want love to:
walk right up and bite me,
Grab a hold of me and fight me, leave
me dying on the ground.
[E]I want love to:
[G]split my mouth wide open, And
[A]cover up my ears and never
[E]let me hear a sound
I want love to:
[G]forget that you offended me,
[A]Or how you have defended me when
[E]everybody tore me down Yeah
and I want love to: chan-
[G]ge my friends to enemies, Chan-
[A]ge my friends to enemies, And show me
[E]how it's all my fault. Yeah

[E]I won't let [G]love disrupt, cor-
[D]rupt or interrupt [A]me
[E]Yeah I won't let [G]love disrupt, cor-
